content.text: The only MFN-type provision runs in our favour, and no obligation burdens the Customer.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The single most-favoured-nation provision in the Agreement (§ 7.6) runs in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. Searches for "no less favourable", "most favoured nation", "favourable", "parity", and "best terms", plus review of the pricing (§ 7), structure/scope (§ 2) and general (§ 30) sections, found no provision requiring Customer to extend Vendor its best terms or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer; Vendor-granted MFN pricing is welcome), so no redline is proposed.
